reason: It's a brand new page and I haven't seen a single TikTok unboxing or heard from anyone who used it, so I'm not sending money up front. And paying 21,000 in fees on 30,000 shoes, then waiting three weeks, when the Baghdad market has something close today, doesn't make sense for my kids' stuff.
objection: I pay the item price first to a company nobody I know has tried. If it never comes or it's wrong, who do I chase? Also the fees are almost as much as the item.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or relative showing me an order they actually got from them, or real unboxing videos on TikTok of their deliveries in Baghdad.
